notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Composite Golem.
description:
At the beginning of combat during your turn, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
